page: OVHcloud b2-60 is a general-purpose cloud server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor operating at 2.0 GHz. The instance delivers 16 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1 thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. It is configured with 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled as a 400 GB local SSD, and the network configuration includes a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps alongside one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates that the b2-60 delivers average multi-core performance but weak single-core performance. Specifically, stress-ng single-core CPU performance and bzip3 single-threaded decompression fall into the bottom 25%, while stress-ng multi-core performance and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests show average read speeds for both small and large blocks, though large block write bandwidth is weak. Geekbench tests, including software compilation, ray tracing, image processing, and text processing, consistently place in the middle 50%.

This server is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading but do not require high single-threaded clock speeds. It is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, and database operations, as evidenced by average scores in Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations. It can also handle light LLM inference tasks, achieving average prompt processing speeds for 135M and 7B models, though text generation for 7B models is weak.
